legal.termsIntro: Welcome to MyVenueBooking. These Terms and Conditions explain the rules for using our venue and event platform, including buying event tickets, booking venues, and applying to become a vendor. By accessing or using the platform, you agree to follow these terms.
legal.termsFooter: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of MyVenueBooking after changes are posted means you accept the updated terms.
legal.termsSection1Item1: You may use MyVenueBooking to browse events, buy tickets, book venues, and request access to become a vendor.
legal.termsSection1Item2: You agree to provide accurate information when creating an account, purchasing tickets, booking venues, or submitting a vendor request.
legal.termsSection1Item3: You are responsible for keeping your login details secure and for all activity that happens through your account.
legal.termsSection2Item1: Ticket availability, pricing, event schedules, venue rules, and seat details may be set by the event organizer or vendor.
legal.termsSection2Item2: After a ticket purchase is completed, you must review your order details carefully because incorrect purchases may not be refundable.
legal.termsSection2Item3: If an event is cancelled, postponed, or changed, we may notify affected users and share the available options provided by the organizer.
legal.termsSection3Item1: Venue booking requests are subject to availability, approval, pricing, and any rules shared by the venue owner or vendor.
legal.termsSection3Item2: You agree to use booked venues responsibly and follow all venue policies, safety rules, timing restrictions, and payment requirements.
legal.termsSection3Item3: Any damage, misuse, or violation of venue rules may result in cancellation, additional charges, or account restrictions.
legal.termsSection4Item1: Users may request to become vendors so they can list events or venues on the platform.
legal.termsSection4Item2: Vendor approval is not guaranteed, and we may review, approve, reject, suspend, or remove vendor access when needed.
legal.termsSection4Item3: Vendors are responsible for keeping event and venue information accurate, including prices, dates, availability, descriptions, images, and policies.
legal.termsSection5Item1: Payments must be completed through the payment methods supported by the platform.
legal.termsSection5Item2: Service fees, booking fees, taxes, or vendor charges may apply and will be shown where relevant during checkout.
legal.termsSection5Item3: Refunds may depend on the event organizer, venue owner, vendor policy, payment provider rules, or applicable law.
legal.termsSection6Item1: You may not use the platform for fraud, fake bookings, unauthorized ticket resale, abusive behavior, illegal activity, or misleading listings.
legal.termsSection6Item2: You may not copy, misuse, interfere with, or attempt to access parts of the platform that are not meant for you.
legal.termsSection6Item3: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms or create risk for users, vendors, or the platform.
legal.privacyIntro: This Privacy Policy explains how MyVenueBooking collects, uses, stores, and shares information when you use our venue and event platform. Our platform allows users to buy tickets for events, book venues, and request vendor access to list their own events or venues.
legal.privacyFooter: We may update this Privacy Policy as our platform grows or legal requirements change. Updated versions will be posted on this page.
legal.privacySection1Item1: Account details such as your name, email address, phone number, password, and profile information.
legal.privacySection1Item2: Booking details such as event tickets purchased, venues requested, dates, quantities, preferences, and order history.
legal.privacySection1Item3: Vendor request information, including business details, event or venue information, listing content, and verification details.
legal.privacySection1Item4: Payment-related information needed to process transactions. Full payment card details are handled by payment providers where applicable.
legal.privacySection1Item5: Technical information such as device data, browser type, IP address, pages visited, and basic usage activity.
legal.privacySection2Item1: To create and manage user accounts, ticket purchases, venue bookings, and vendor requests.
legal.privacySection2Item2: To process payments, confirm bookings, send tickets, share updates, and provide customer support.
legal.privacySection2Item3: To review vendor applications and help vendors manage event or venue listings.
legal.privacySection2Item4: To improve platform performance, personalize the user experience, prevent fraud, and keep the platform secure.
legal.privacySection2Item5: To send service messages, booking updates, important notices, and promotional communication where allowed.
legal.privacySection3Item1: We may share booking details with event organizers, venue owners, or approved vendors when needed to complete your ticket purchase or venue booking.
legal.privacySection3Item2: We may share limited information with payment processors, hosting providers, analytics tools, and support services that help us operate the platform.
legal.privacySection3Item3: We do not sell your personal information to third parties.
legal.privacySection3Item4: We may disclose information if required by law, to protect our rights, or to prevent fraud, abuse, or security risks.
legal.privacySection4Item1: We may use cookies and similar technologies to keep you signed in, remember preferences, understand traffic, and improve the platform.
legal.privacySection4Item2: You can control cookies through your browser settings, but some platform features may not work properly if cookies are disabled.
legal.privacySection5Item1: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, loss, misuse, or disclosure.
legal.privacySection5Item2: We keep personal information only for as long as needed for platform operations, legal requirements, dispute resolution, fraud prevention, and record keeping.
legal.privacySection6Item1: You may update your account information from your profile or contact support if you need help.
legal.privacySection6Item2: You may request access, correction, deletion, or restriction of your personal information where applicable law allows.
legal.privacySection6Item3: You may unsubscribe from promotional messages, but we may still send important account, booking, or security notices.
